verdict.rationale: Productboard offers building blocks for background automation rather than a native automation feature. Webhooks push real-time change events to your endpoint, the REST API and MCP server let external scripts or agents update data and "automate prioritization workflows," and the product automatically detects insights in incoming feedback. Any user-configured autonomous automation must be built and hosted outside Productboard. Missing for 10: native user-configurable automation or workflow rules, scheduled or triggered background agents inside Productboard, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
